LESSON: SONGS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.3: Songs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Songs. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What does good singing involve?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. sing different types of songs applying performance techniques
2. perform the East African Community Anthem in unison
3. identify types of folk songs performed by indigenous Kenyan communities

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. sing different types of songs applying performance techniques
   In simple words: practise until you can sing different types of songs applying performance techniques. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. perform the East African Community Anthem in unison
   In simple words: practise until you can perform the East African Community Anthem in unison. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. identify types of folk songs performed by indigenous Kenyan communities
   In simple words: practise until you can identify types of folk songs performed by indigenous Kenyan communities. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Songs using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Songs in the examples.
2. Explain Songs to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Songs.
4. Show that you can: sing different types of songs applying performance techniques

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Songs using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Songs important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Listen to and identify different types of songs,
2. Sing different types of songs with accuracy in pitch and rhythm adhering to performance directions and applying appropriate performance techniques,
3. Discuss the messages of the songs and demonstrate how the mood of the songs can be expressed while singing,
4. Listen to a live or recorded performance of the East African Community Anthem in unison, with peers, discuss and internalise the words of the anthem, What does good singing involve? 19
5. Practise singing East African Community Anthem in unison observing performance techniques and etiquette,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. sing different types of songs applying performance techniques
2. perform the East African Community Anthem in unison
3. identify types of folk songs performed by indigenous Kenyan communities

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
